description: Calm Your Nerves | Veena Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of slow Indian classical veena to settle an anxious evening.
When your body won't come off alert — jaw tight, chest high, thoughts circling — this is ninety minutes of slow, warm veena in Raga Darbari to bring your nervous system down gently.
🎧 HOW TO USE — low volume, evening light low. Breathe slower than the music. Nothing here spikes or surprises.
⏱ BEST FOR — evening anxiety · unwinding after a hard day · settling before sleep · slow breathing practice
🎵 ABOUT — the veena is one of India's oldest instruments, its deep rounded tone long associated with steadiness and contemplation. Raga Darbari is the midnight raga of gravity and calm.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, slow gentle South Indian veena in Raga Darbari, soft rounded plucked phrases over a warm tanpura drone, no percussion, ~55 BPM, tender and spacious, deeply calming late-evening character, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: MAY-GRADE CALM (retention fix). Zero upbeat/energetic terms. Darbari = banked evening/gravity raga; differentiates from Sat's Yaman. No tabla.
